Nina (eng-platform): Quick flag: invoice-preview jumped ~9k tokens for a set of EU tenants after we toggled the routing soft-fail TTL to 75s. Anyone tracking?
Liam (billing): saw it. Preview alert triggered, but final invoices looked stable this morning.
Harper (ingest): likely late-arriving retries. The proxy appends a retry suffix to request ids on fallback paths. Preview de-dupe uses req_id atm.
Nina (eng-platform): that would explain it. Finalizer dedupes on routing_fingerprint, so preview and final diverge.
Liam (billing): customers confused by preview spikes. Can preview aggregation prefer fingerprint instead?
Harper (ingest): short-term fix: change streaming-agg to prefer routing_fingerprint when present, fall back to req_id. I'll open PR.
DevConsoleBot: [info] streaming-agg: duplicate-rate alert at 2026-03-21T19:03:21Z
Nina (eng-platform): plan: Harper PR + unit test simulating req_id mutation, rollback TTL for affected cohort if needed, console banner explaining preview semantics.
Liam (billing): I'll ping support and update billing FAQ with a note about preview vs finalized.
Harper (ingest): PR up in 30m, estimating 2h for rollout + verification.
Nina (eng-platform): thanks. Keep updates here, and let's avoid firing tenant-facing preview alerts until dedupe patch lands.
